title: A Week of Scandal, Reckoning and Resignations in Congress

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，陈列着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: After serious allegations, including sexual misconduct claims, Congress was on the cusp of doing something that has never happened in U.S.
sentences.zh: 在面临包括性行为不端指控在内的严重指控后，国会正处于采取一项美国历史上从未有过的行动的边缘。

sentences.en: history.
sentences.zh: 历史。

sentences.en: Forcibly remove four of its members.
sentences.zh: 强制罢免其四名成员。

sentences.en: But then, within about an hour of one another, two of those members resigned.
sentences.zh: 但随后，在大约一小时内，其中两名成员辞职了。

sentences.en: Today, congressional reporter Michael Gold explains what unfolded on Capitol Hill this week and what it tells us about how willing Congress is to hold itself accountable.
sentences.zh: 今天，国会记者迈克尔·戈尔将解释本周国会山发生了什么，以及这反映出国会对于自我问责的意愿如何。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 17.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月17日，星期五。

sentences.en: Michael Gold, welcome to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·戈尔，欢迎来到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: It has been, as you know, a very chaotic week on Capitol Hill because, among other things, it is extremely uncommon for us to see two members of Congress step down within, what,
sentences.zh: 如你所知，本周国会山非常混乱，因为除其他事项外，我们看到两名国会议员在，怎么说呢，

sentences.en: an hour or two of each other?
sentences.zh: 一两个小时内相继辞职，这是极其罕见的。

sentences.en: And we're going to get to the specific allegations that led to the resignations in a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会谈到导致这些辞职的具体指控。

sentences.en: But I just want to start by hearing from you about how you're thinking about what we saw unfold this week.
sentences.zh: 但我首先想听听你对本周所见所闻的看法。

sentences.en: I've been thinking a lot about what's happening on the Hill this week.
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考本周国会山发生的事情。

sentences.en: And for me, this is a story about the way that Congress chooses or doesn't choose to police itself.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是一个关于国会选择或不选择如何自我监管的故事。

sentences.en: I think what we're seeing this week is extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们本周所见是非同寻常的。

sentences.en: Two members of the House resigning within an hour of each other after a lot of pressure.
sentences.zh: 两名众议院议员在巨大压力下，在一小时内相继辞职。

sentences.en: But it took us a while to get to this point.
sentences.zh: 但我们走到这一步花了不少时间。

sentences.en: And I think the way that it happened really says a lot about kind of the intersection between our politics and the way we expect our politicians to behave once they're in office.
sentences.zh: 我认为事情发生的方式确实说明了我们的政治与我们对官员在职期间行为的期望之间的交集。

sentences.en: It took us a while to get here.
sentences.zh: 我们走到这一步花了不少时间。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that, Michael?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'm going to answer your question with another question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我要用另一个问题来回答你的问题。

sentences.en: Do you remember George Santos?
sentences.zh: 你还记得乔治·桑托斯吗？

sentences.en: George Santos, the former Republican congressman who was kicked out of Congress, is now on Cameo for hire for birthdays and other sort of greetings.
sentences.zh: 乔治·桑托斯，那位被逐出国会的前共和党众议员，现在在Cameo上接单，为生日或其他场合录制问候视频。

sentences.en: That George Santos, yes, I remember him in large part because of your reporting, I believe, Michael.
sentences.zh: 那位乔治·桑托斯，是的，我记得他，很大程度上是因为你的报道，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So what does that have to do with the situation we're in now?
sentences.zh: 那么这和我们现在的处境有什么关系？

sentences.en: So let me take you back to 2023.
sentences.zh: 让我带你回到2023年。

sentences.en: George Santos arrives in Congress facing a cloud of questions, most of them sparked by my colleague Grace Ashford and I,
sentences.zh: 乔治·桑托斯来到国会时，头顶笼罩着一片质疑的阴云，其中大部分是由我和我的同事格蕾丝·阿什福德引发的，

sentences.en: who reported that he had lied about his background, where his campaign money came from.
sentences.zh: 我们报道了他对自己背景以及竞选资金来源的谎言。

sentences.en: He claimed to be this big Wall Street guy and no one seemed to really know where the money was or what had happened to it.
sentences.zh: 他自称是华尔街大亨，但似乎没人知道钱在哪里，或者钱去了哪里。

sentences.en: And so when he arrived, there were a lot of members of Congress who said this man lied his way into office and we don't think he should be in the House.
sentences.zh: 所以当他到任时，许多国会议员说，这个人是靠撒谎才当选的，我们认为他不应该留在众议院。

sentences.en: And Kevin McCarthy, who was a speaker at the time, said, we can't kick somebody out of the House based on newspaper articles.
sentences.zh: 而当时的议长凯文·麦卡锡说，我们不能仅仅根据报纸文章就把人踢出众议院。

sentences.en: We don't have enough here.
sentences.zh: 我们掌握的证据还不够。

sentences.en: There are investigations we can take.
sentences.zh: 我们可以进行调查。

sentences.en: And if you all really want to figure out what's going on with George Santos, let's do an ethics committee investigation.
sentences.zh: 如果你们真的想弄清楚乔治·桑托斯身上发生了什么，让我们进行一次道德委员会调查吧。

sentences.en: So they do.
sentences.zh: 于是他们做了。

sentences.en: And traditionally, ethics committee investigations move very slowly.
sentences.zh: 传统上，道德委员会的调查进展非常缓慢。

sentences.en: It's kind of known by lawmakers that when something gets kicked over to the House Ethics Committee, it's going to take a while for it to be resolved.
sentences.zh: 立法者们都知道，当事情被踢给众议院道德委员会时，解决它需要很长时间。

sentences.en: And it's kind of a way for everyone to get some cover and say, well, we're investigating this, but we need to give this investigation time to play out.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是让每个人都能有个掩护，说，嗯，我们正在调查，但我们需要给调查时间去推进。

sentences.en: And there needs to be some due process.
sentences.zh: 而且需要有正当程序。

sentences.en: And then we'll deal with the issue.
sentences.zh: 然后我们再处理这个问题。

sentences.en: But in Santos's case, it took less than a year for the ethics committee to come back and release this report that found substantial evidence of campaign finance fraud,
sentences.zh: 但在桑托斯的案例中，道德委员会不到一年就发布了这份报告，发现了竞选财务欺诈的实质性证据，

sentences.en: of violating House ethics rules.
sentences.zh: 以及违反众议院道德准则的证据。

sentences.en: There are a lot of damning details about him spending the money on things like Botox and OnlyFans subscription.
sentences.zh: 报告中有很多令人震惊的细节，关于他把钱花在肉毒杆菌（Botox）和OnlyFans订阅上。

sentences.en: And basically, a bunch of Republicans and Democrats come together and say, enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 基本上，一群共和党人和民主党人联合起来说，受够了。

sentences.en: We're going to vote to expel him.
sentences.zh: 我们要投票将他驱逐。

sentences.en: A vote takes a two-thirds majority of the House.
sentences.zh: 投票需要众议院三分之二的多数票。

sentences.en: They clear that bar easily.
sentences.zh: 他们轻松达到了这个门槛。

sentences.en: And George Santos is removed from office.
sentences.zh: 乔治·桑托斯被免职了。

sentences.en: Basically, they kicked him out.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们把他踢出去了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一件大事。

sentences.en: They kicked him out.
sentences.zh: 他们把他踢出去了。

sentences.en: Before Santos, only five people in the history of the House had been expelled.
sentences.zh: 在桑托斯之前，众议院历史上只有五个人被驱逐过。

sentences.en: Three of them were kicked out because they fought for the Confederacy against the United States, which was basically seen as an act of treason.
sentences.zh: 其中三人是因为为美利坚联盟国而战，这基本上被视为叛国罪。

sentences.en: And two of them had been convicted of felony charges.
sentences.zh: 另外两人被判犯有重罪。

sentences.en: And their trials had gone through the whole process and they had been convicted.
sentences.zh: 他们的审判走完了整个流程，并被定罪了。

sentences.en: In other words, George Santos basically teaches us that the House can move quickly if it wants to.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，乔治·桑托斯基本上教会了我们，如果众议院想的话，它可以行动得很快。

sentences.en: It can speed up this otherwise kind of slow process that an ethics committee investigation takes.
sentences.zh: 它可以加速道德委员会调查这种原本缓慢的过程。

sentences.en: And it can get the justification that it needs in order to vote to expel a member.
sentences.zh: 并且它可以获得投票驱逐议员所需的正当理由。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When the House is pressed and when it feels like there's urgency, Santos' expulsion shows it will find a way to get rid of people who it thinks should not be in its midSt.
sentences.zh: 当众议院受到压力，感到紧迫时，桑托斯的驱逐案表明，它会找到办法清除那些它认为不该留在其中的人。

sentences.en: And this was kind of a sign that the House was capable of policing itself when it saw misconduct that it thought was so beyond the pale that it had violated the oath that lawmakers took,
sentences.zh: 这是一种信号，表明众议院在看到它认为极其恶劣、违反了立法者誓言的不当行为时，是有能力自我监管的，

sentences.en: that it had violated the public trust that members are supposed to have with the American people.
sentences.zh: 这违反了议员与美国人民之间应有的公众信任。

sentences.en: Well, they said, enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们说，受够了。

sentences.en: We need to kick this guy out.
sentences.zh: 我们需要把这家伙踢出去。

sentences.en: We don't want him here.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要他在这里。

sentences.en: And this was something they had really been reluctant to do because representatives see themselves as being elected by their constituents.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他们一直不愿做的事情，因为代表们认为自己是由选民选出的。

sentences.en: They answer to their constituents.
sentences.zh: 他们对选民负责。

sentences.en: And the general sense was that it was up to lawmakers and their constituents to decide whether they wanted to stay in their seat.
sentences.zh: 普遍的看法是，是否留任由立法者及其选民决定。

sentences.en: And in Santos' case, his colleagues basically took the decision out of everyone's hands and said, we're getting him out of here.
sentences.zh: 而在桑托斯的案例中，他的同事们基本上剥夺了所有人的决定权，说，我们要把他赶出去。

sentences.en: We want somebody who we think is more suited to the office.
sentences.zh: 我们想要一个我们认为更适合这个职位的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One way of reading this and reading the sort of the hesitancy that you're describing is that Congress is basically undoing what voters said they wanted.
sentences.zh: 解读这一点以及你所描述的那种犹豫的一种方式是，国会基本上是在推翻选民的意愿。

sentences.en: They vote somebody in and you, Congress, are saying, nope, we have decided to kick him out.
sentences.zh: 他们投票选出某人，而你们国会却说，不，我们决定把他踢出去。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the House's decision to eventually remove him from office really set the stage for what we saw this week with Eric Swalwell and Tony Gonzalez.
sentences.zh: 众议院最终将其免职的决定，确实为我们本周在埃里克·斯沃韦尔和托尼·冈萨雷斯身上看到的情况奠定了基础。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These are the two congressmen who resigned this week.
sentences.zh: 这就是本周辞职的两名国会议员。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that, though?
sentences.zh: 不过你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: What is the connective tissue between these two events?
sentences.zh: 这两件事之间的联系是什么？

sentences.en: So I think we should start with Tony Gonzalez.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该从托尼·冈萨雷斯开始说起。

sentences.en: He's a Republican from Texas whose district runs along the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他是来自德克萨斯州的共和党人，他的选区沿着美国与墨西哥的边境延伸。

sentences.en: border with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 今年二月，

sentences.en: And in February of this year,
sentences.zh: 一篇新闻文章出炉，指控他与一名自焚身亡的助手存在强制性的性关系。

sentences.en: a news article comes out accusing him of having a coercive sexual relationship with one of his aides who had killed herself by setting herself on fire.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我记得那件事。

sentences.en: God, I remember that.
sentences.zh: 那是一个可怕的故事。

sentences.en: It was a horrific story.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And there were text messages that were pretty damning that show that he was repeatedly texting her, pushing her for photos,
sentences.zh: 有一些相当令人震惊的短信显示，他反复给她发短信，逼她发照片，

sentences.en: pushing her for a relationship that she sort of reluctantly agreed to.
sentences.zh: 逼她维持一段她勉强同意的关系。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of women on the Hill who read those messages sort of recognize this pattern where men ask repeatedly for things and women are so worn down that they feel abrogated.
sentences.zh: 你知道，国会里许多读到这些信息的女性都认出了这种模式：男性反复索取，女性被磨得精疲力竭，感到被迫屈从。

sentences.en: And in this case, this man was her boss.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这个男人是她的老板。

sentences.en: So there was a sense that this was just very coercive.
sentences.zh: 所以人们认为这非常具有强制性。

sentences.en: And frankly, the dramatic way in which she died, her lighting herself on fire, I think, really horrified everybody.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，她死亡的方式——自焚，我认为真的让每个人都感到恐惧。

sentences.en: It was just the kind of details of the story were really gruesome and disgusted a lot of people here.
sentences.zh: 故事的细节非常惨烈，让这里很多人感到恶心。

sentences.en: Obviously, Michael, a lot of companies and institutions have rules prohibiting romantic relationships between managers or other folks in power and subordinates.
sentences.zh: 显然，迈克尔，许多公司和机构都有禁止管理者或其他掌权者与下属之间发生浪漫关系的规定。

sentences.en: So in 2018, the House passed a rule that forbid its members expressly from having affairs with their own staff.
sentences.zh: 所以2018年，众议院通过了一项规则，明确禁止议员与自己的员工发生婚外情。

sentences.en: And Gonzalez violated that rule and he admits to violating that rule.
sentences.zh: 冈萨雷斯违反了那条规则，他也承认了这一点。

sentences.en: He comes out and says, you know, very, very direct, Pags, I made a mistake and I had a lapse in judgment and there was a lack of faith.
sentences.zh: 他站出来说，你知道，非常直接，帕格斯，我犯了一个错误，我判断失误，缺乏信念。

sentences.en: I made a lapse in judgment.
sentences.zh: 我判断失误了。

sentences.en: I'm going to end my reelection campaign.
sentences.zh: 我将结束我的连任竞选。

sentences.en: You know, I've lost the trust in my voters, so I can't run for office again.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我失去了选民的信任，所以我不能再竞选公职了。

sentences.en: I look forward to the ethics committee starting an investigation.
sentences.zh: 我期待道德委员会开始调查。

sentences.en: I appreciate the opportunity to be able to provide all the facts and all the details.
sentences.zh: 我很感谢有机会提供所有事实和细节。

sentences.en: And Speaker Mike Johnson says, OK, well, he's ending his reelection campaign.
sentences.zh: 议长迈克·约翰逊说，好吧，他要结束连任竞选了。

sentences.en: That's the equivalent of the political death penalty.
sentences.zh: 这相当于政治死刑。

sentences.en: This is done.
sentences.zh: 这事儿完了。

sentences.en: We don't have to worry about this anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们不必再担心这个了。

sentences.en: But that strikes a lot of lawmakers as the incorrect way to handle the situation.
sentences.zh: 但这让许多立法者觉得处理这种情况的方式不对。

sentences.en: Because if you admit to violating a rule that the House passed to hold itself accountable, a lot of lawmakers argue that you shouldn't get to pick the punishment,
sentences.zh: 因为如果你承认违反了国会为自我问责而通过的规则，许多立法者认为你不应该自己选择惩罚方式，

sentences.en: that the House should be the ones deciding what happens to you.
sentences.zh: 而应该由国会来决定如何处置你。

sentences.en: And your decision to end your reelection campaign isn't enough because at this point, there are months left in Congress.
sentences.zh: 而且你结束连任竞选的决定还不够，因为此时国会任期还有几个月。

sentences.en: You're still in your seat and you broke a rule.
sentences.zh: 你还在职位上，而且你违反了规则。

sentences.en: And so what do these members want to see done instead of what Gonzalez has proposed?
sentences.zh: 那么这些议员希望看到什么，而不是冈萨雷斯提出的方案？

sentences.en: Calls for Republican Congressman Tony Gonzalez's resignation are intensifying, including from members of his own party.
sentences.zh: 要求共和党众议员托尼·冈萨雷斯辞职的呼声越来越高，包括来自他自己党派成员的呼声。

sentences.en: I think it needs to go.
sentences.zh: 我认为他必须走人。

sentences.en: I just, that's the line.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，这就是底线。

sentences.en: Given what I've seen so far, he should resign.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我目前所看到的，他应该辞职。

sentences.en: Well, a number of Republicans and Democrats are arguing that he should be expelled for this misconduct.
sentences.zh: 嗯，许多共和党人和民主党人都在争论，他应该因为这种不当行为被驱逐。

sentences.en: He exploited his younger staffers.
sentences.zh: 他剥削了他的年轻员工。

sentences.en: I don't think that he brings honor to the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他为众议院带来了荣誉。

sentences.en: But Speaker Johnson says, if you all want to pursue discipline, the way to handle this is the way we always handle this.
sentences.zh: 但议长约翰逊说，如果你们都想追究纪律，处理这件事的方法就是我们一贯的处理方式。

sentences.en: Let's send this issue to the ethics committee.
sentences.zh: 让我们把这个问题送到道德委员会。

sentences.en: They can investigate it.
sentences.zh: 他们可以调查。

sentences.en: We'll see what they say and we'll go from there.
sentences.zh: 我们会看看他们怎么说，然后从那里开始。

sentences.en: Basically, the Speaker is arguing, despite the pressure, angry calls for more severe action.
sentences.zh: 基本上，议长在争辩，尽管有压力，有要求采取更严厉行动的愤怒呼声，

sentences.en: Look, there is a process that needs to be followed, which on the one hand, that is true.
sentences.zh: 看，有一个必须遵循的程序，一方面，这是事实。

sentences.en: It makes complete sense because it allows for members to have due process.
sentences.zh: 这完全说得通，因为它允许议员获得正当程序。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, he's already admitted to breaking the rules.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，他已经承认违反了规则。

sentences.en: And as you said earlier, going through a full investigative process is traditionally pretty slow.
sentences.zh: 而且正如你之前所说，走完完整的调查程序传统上是非常缓慢的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's what he's saying publicly.
sentences.zh: 这就是他公开说的。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of people who cover the Hill and a lot of the members of Congress themselves look at this and think there's something else going on here.
sentences.zh: 但我认为许多报道国会的人和许多国会议员自己看着这件事，认为这里面还有别的事情。

sentences.en: And that's politics.
sentences.zh: 那就是政治。

sentences.en: Because at this point, Speaker Mike Johnson is looking at a very narrow majority in the House.
sentences.zh: 因为此时，议长迈克·约翰逊在众议院面临着非常微弱的多数优势。

sentences.en: If he wants to pass through major legislation, he can really only afford to lose one or two votes.
sentences.zh: 如果他想通过重大立法，他真的只能承受一两票的流失。

sentences.en: And losing Gonzalez would make it even harder for him to push through major agenda iteMs.
sentences.zh: 失去冈萨雷斯会让他更难推动重大议程项目。

sentences.en: And so there are a lot of questions about whether this is a question of due process and is this about thorough investigation or is this about politics?
sentences.zh: 所以有很多问题，这到底是正当程序的问题，是关于彻底调查的问题，还是关于政治的问题？

sentences.en: That's an open question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: And that's where things remain until the news about Eric Swalwell breaks.
sentences.zh: 这就是在埃里克·斯沃韦尔的消息传出之前，事情所处的状态。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.

I use a different starting word every day.

sentences.en: So, Michael, to the extent that people know about Eric Swalwell, what they might know is that he's a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，就人们对埃里克·斯沃韦尔的了解程度而言，他们可能只知道他是一位民主党人。

sentences.en: He's often on TV taking on the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 他经常在电视上抨击特朗普政府。

sentences.en: But tell us a little bit more about him, like his rise in politics and these accusations against him.
sentences.zh: 但请多给我们介绍一下他，比如他在政坛的崛起以及针对他的这些指控。

sentences.en: So Eric Swalwell is a Democrat from Northern California, from around San Francisco Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·斯沃韦尔是来自北加州的一位民主党人，来自旧金山湾区附近。

sentences.en: With over 80 percent of precincts reporting, I am proud to say that new energy and ideas are coming to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 随着超过80%的选区完成计票，我很自豪地说，新的活力和思想正在进入华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: And he comes to Congress in 2013.
sentences.zh: 他在2013年进入国会。

sentences.en: It's very exciting.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: This morning we got the keys to the office.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我们拿到了办公室的钥匙。

sentences.en: Ends up on the House Intelligence Committee, which is a pretty plum assignment for a lot of lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 他最终进入了众议院情报委员会，这对许多议员来说是一个相当不错的职位。

sentences.en: Briefly runs for president in 2020, which starts to elevate his profile.
sentences.zh: 他在2020年短暂竞选总统，这开始提升了他的知名度。

sentences.en: But he really becomes a major figure in the party the following year, in 2021, when he serves as an impeachment manager during the second impeachment trial of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但他真正成为党内重要人物是在第二年，即2021年，当时他在唐纳德·特朗普的第二次弹劾审判中担任弹劾经理。

sentences.en: But we have a case to make, and whether it's tonight or it's in two weeks, the evidence won't change.
sentences.zh: 但我们有理由提出诉讼，无论是在今晚还是两周后，证据都不会改变。

sentences.en: The president incited our citizens to attack our Capitol, and once that happens...
sentences.zh: 总统煽动我们的公民攻击我们的国会大厦，一旦发生这种情况……

sentences.en: And from there, he becomes kind of a fixture on MSNBC.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他成了MSNBC的常客。

sentences.en: Donald Trump is a broken man who has broken all of his promises, and we're all starting to pay for it, and we're going to be a broken country pretty soon.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普是一个破碎的人，他打破了所有的承诺，我们所有人都在开始为此付出代价，我们很快就会成为一个破碎的国家。

sentences.en: He becomes kind of the face and kind of a golden boy of Democratic politics.
sentences.zh: 他成了民主党政治的门面和某种“金童”。

sentences.en: Our next guest is a popular member of the House.
sentences.zh: 我们的下一位嘉宾是众议院的一位受欢迎的成员。

sentences.en: He does battle daily with the forces of MAGA.
sentences.zh: 他每天都在与“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）势力作斗争。

sentences.en: Please welcome Congressman Eric Swalwell.
sentences.zh: 请欢迎国会议员埃里克·斯沃韦尔。

sentences.en: He's very, very prominent, and...
sentences.zh: 他非常、非常突出，而且……

sentences.en: I came here tonight, Jimmy, to tell you and your audience that I'm running to be the next governor of California.
sentences.zh: 吉米，我今晚来到这里，是为了告诉你和你的观众，我正在竞选下一任加州州长。

sentences.en: He decides to run for governor of California this year,
sentences.zh: 他决定今年竞选加州州长，

sentences.en: and partially because of his media profile, because he's been on TV so much, because he's become one of the leading anti-Trump figures in the party.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是他的媒体形象，因为他经常上电视，因为他已经成为党内领先的反特朗普人物之一。

sentences.en: New polling shows East Bank Representative Eric Swalwell gaining a lead in the governor's race.
sentences.zh: 新的民调显示，东岸代表埃里克·斯沃韦尔在州长竞选中取得领先。

sentences.en: He very quickly becomes a fronter in this race.
sentences.zh: 他很快就成为了这场竞选的领跑者。

sentences.en: And the primary in that election's in June, and it looks like Swalwell is going to be one of the top contenders until...
sentences.zh: 那场选举的初选在六月，看起来斯沃韦尔将成为顶级竞争者之一，直到……

sentences.en: New tonight, CNN with exclusive reporting about Congressman Eric Swalwell.
sentences.zh: 今晚最新消息，CNN关于国会议员埃里克·斯沃韦尔的独家报道。

sentences.en: These accusations of sexual misconduct break this month.
sentences.zh: 这些性行为不端的指控在本月爆发。

sentences.en: And explain those accusations.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这些指控。

sentences.en: I kept figuring out ways to blame myself.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想办法责怪自己。

sentences.en: I shouldn't have reached out to him at all.
sentences.zh: 我根本就不该联系他。

sentences.en: I should have left.
sentences.zh: 我应该离开的。

sentences.en: I should have done this.
sentences.zh: 我本该做点别的。

sentences.en: Well, Eric shouldn't have raped me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，埃里克本不该强奸我。

sentences.en: So in articles in the San Francisco Chronicle and on CNN,
sentences.zh: 所以在《旧金山纪事报》和CNN的文章中，

sentences.en: Swalwell is accused of sexually assaulting a former aide?
sentences.zh: 斯沃韦尔被指控性侵了一名前助手？

sentences.en: I went to the bathroom, and I don't remember anything after that.
sentences.zh: 我去了洗手间，之后的事我什么都不记得了。

sentences.en: You don't remember anything?
sentences.zh: 你什么都不记得了？

sentences.en: I remember the next day, I can see flashes of that evening of him on top of me, me pushing him off, him grabbing me.
sentences.zh: 我记得第二天，我脑海中闪过那天晚上的片段：他在我身上，我把他推开，他抓住我。

sentences.en: It was a lot more aggressive.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况要激烈得多。

sentences.en: It was aggressive.
sentences.zh: 确实很激烈。

sentences.en: Did you say no?
sentences.zh: 你拒绝了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I said no.
sentences.zh: 我说不。

sentences.en: And he is accused of sexual harassment and misconduct against other women who say that he used his position to pursue sexual relationships with them,
sentences.zh: 而且他被指控对其他女性进行性骚扰和不当行为，她们称他利用自己的职位追求与她们的性关系，

sentences.en: send them nude photos, and generally behaved inappropriately.
sentences.zh: 给她们发送裸照，并且行为普遍不检点。

sentences.en: A lot has been said about me today through anonymous allegations.
sentences.zh: 今天通过匿名指控，关于我的说法有很多。

sentences.en: And I thought it was important that you see and hear from me directly.
sentences.zh: 我认为让你们直接看到并听到我的回应很重要。

sentences.en: These allegations of sexual assault are flat false.
sentences.zh: 这些性侵指控完全是虚假的。

sentences.en: They are absolutely false.
sentences.zh: 它们绝对是假的。

sentences.en: And Swalwell denies all these accusations.
sentences.zh: 斯沃韦尔否认了所有这些指控。

sentences.en: He denies them right after the articles come out last Friday.
sentences.zh: 在上周五文章发表后，他立即否认了这些指控。

sentences.en: They did not happen.
sentences.zh: 这些事并没有发生。

sentences.en: They have never happened.
sentences.zh: 它们从未发生过。

sentences.en: And I will fight them with everything that I have.
sentences.zh: 我将用我所拥有的一切来反击它们。

sentences.en: He insists that he plans to fight them.
sentences.zh: 他坚持说他计划反击这些指控。

sentences.en: But these articles, when they came out, were shocking.
sentences.zh: 但这些文章出来时，确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: I mean, they were really shocking for a lot of people, Republicans and Democrats alike.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这对很多人来说真的很震惊，无论是共和党人还是民主党人。

sentences.en: And almost immediately, he starts to lose support.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，他开始失去支持。

sentences.en: A number of Democrats, basically all of them, who had endorsed his campaign for governor, withdraw their endorsements.
sentences.zh: 许多民主党人，基本上是所有支持他竞选州长的人，都撤回了他们的支持。

sentences.en: And many of them are calling for him to drop out.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人呼吁他退选。

sentences.en: And the House knows that they're going to have to deal with these accusations when they return to session.
sentences.zh: 众议院也知道，当他们回到会议时，他们将不得不处理这些指控。

sentences.en: And that also puts a spotlight back on Tony Gonzalez.
sentences.zh: 这也让托尼·冈萨雷斯再次受到关注。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think it's worth mentioning that in the time since that first accusation that Gonzalez has admitted to,
sentences.zh: 我认为值得一提的是，在冈萨雷斯承认的那次最初指控之后，

sentences.en: he also faces a new accusation that he engaged in similar sexual misconduct with a former campaign aide.
sentences.zh: 他还面临一项新的指控，称他与一名前竞选助手有类似的性行为不端。

sentences.en: And Gonzalez has not addressed that allegation.
sentences.zh: 冈萨雷斯还没有回应那项指控。

sentences.en: So at this point in time, we now have two members of Congress facing very serious allegations of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 所以目前，我们现在有两名国会议员面临非常严重的性行为不端指控。

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think it's worth pointing out that one of them, Eric Swalwell, is a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 我认为值得指出的是，其中一人，埃里克·斯沃韦尔，是民主党人。

sentences.en: And one of them, Tony Gonzalez, is a Republican.
sentences.zh: 而其中一人，托尼·冈萨雷斯，是共和党人。

sentences.en: And so over the weekend, Representative Anna Paulina Luna, who is a Republican from Florida, kind of a MAGA acolyte, very much in that mold,
sentences.zh: 所以周末期间，来自佛罗里达州的共和党代表安娜·保利娜·卢纳，某种程度上是MAGA的追随者，非常符合那种模式，

sentences.en: and Representative Teresa Ledger Fernandez, who's a dyed-in-the-wool Democrat, start talking.
sentences.zh: 以及坚定的民主党人特蕾莎·莱杰·费尔南德斯代表，开始进行讨论。

sentences.en: And these women say that these allegations are serious, and they would like to expel both of these men from Congress.
sentences.zh: 这些女性表示，这些指控很严重，她们希望将这两名男子逐出国会。

sentences.en: And they know that that's a more practical approach, because essentially, you can take out one Democrat, take out one Republican,
sentences.zh: 她们知道这是一种更务实的方法，因为从本质上讲，你可以除掉一名民主党人，除掉一名共和党人，

sentences.en: and the numbers pretty much remain the same politically.
sentences.zh: 在政治上，人数基本保持不变。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, these accusations are very serious.
sentences.zh: 所以明确一点，这些指控非常严重。

sentences.en: They are being taken very seriously.
sentences.zh: 它们正被非常严肃地对待。

sentences.en: But there is also a political calculation that is influencing what is happening in Congress in this moment.
sentences.zh: 但也有政治算计在影响着此刻国会正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 那是对的。

sentences.en: And these allegations against Swalwell and Gonzalez sort of set off a chain reaction.
sentences.zh: 针对斯沃韦尔和冈萨雷斯的这些指控引发了一种连锁反应。

sentences.en: And so now, people are looking at misconduct allegations against two other members of Congress, one Democrat and one Republican.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，人们正在审视针对另外两名国会议员的不当行为指控，一名民主党人，一名共和党人。

sentences.en: And tell us about them.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我们关于他们的情况。

sentences.en: So the Republican is Corey Mills from Florida.
sentences.zh: 共和党人是来自佛罗里达州的科里·米尔斯。

sentences.en: And Mills is facing a number of accusations that he might have violated campaign finance rules, that he threatened to release revenge porn of an ex of his.
sentences.zh: 米尔斯面临多项指控，称他可能违反了竞选财务规则，并威胁要发布他前任的复仇色情内容。

sentences.en: There are some questions about assault allegations.
sentences.zh: 关于性侵指控还有一些疑问。

sentences.en: There are a whole host of behavioral issues that are being explored with Corey Mills.
sentences.zh: 科里·米尔斯身上还有一系列正在调查的行为问题。

sentences.en: And the Democrat is Sheila Sheffelis-McCormick.
sentences.zh: 民主党人是希拉·谢菲利斯-麦考密克。

sentences.en: She's from Florida.
sentences.zh: 她来自佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: And she was accused by federal prosecutors of embezzling money from FEMA and putting that money into her campaign.
sentences.zh: 她被联邦检察官指控从联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）挪用资金，并将这些钱投入到她的竞选中。

sentences.en: And the House Ethics Committee has also been investigating her.
sentences.zh: 众议院道德委员会也一直在调查她。

sentences.en: And they've been investigating her for two years.
sentences.zh: 他们已经调查她两年了。

sentences.en: And earlier this year, released a report that found substantial evidence that she had committed crimes.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，他们发布了一份报告，发现了她犯罪的大量证据。

sentences.en: We should just point out here that there's obviously a huge gulf between these types of accusations you've just described.
sentences.zh: 我们应该指出，你刚才描述的这些指控类型之间显然存在巨大的鸿沟。

sentences.en: We've got three men with a host of sexual misconduct allegations against them.
sentences.zh: 我们有三名男性面临一系列性行为不端指控。

sentences.en: We've got a woman with embezzlement allegations against her.
sentences.zh: 我们有一名女性面临挪用公款的指控。

sentences.en: But all four of them in this moment are basically being lumped in together.
sentences.zh: 但此刻他们四个人基本上都被归为一类了。

sentences.en: And I just want to add, both Mills and McCormick have also denied any wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 我只想补充一点，米尔斯和麦考密克也都否认有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's a sense in which the accusations against Swalwell and Gonzalez have really drawn attention to misconduct in the House.
sentences.zh: 是的，在某种意义上，针对斯沃韦尔和冈萨雷斯的指控确实引起了人们对众议院不当行为的关注。

sentences.en: And at the same time, there are these two other members who are facing very serious misconduct allegations.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，还有另外两名成员面临非常严重的不当行为指控。

sentences.en: And now you have two Democrats and two Republicans,
sentences.zh: 现在你有两名民主党人和两名共和党人，

sentences.en: all of whom are kind of bound up in this push by members of the House to demonstrate to their constituents that they take accusations seriously.
sentences.zh: 他们都被卷入了众议院成员的推动中，以向选民证明他们认真对待这些指控。

sentences.en: And they are very concerned about the conduct of their colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他们非常担心同事的行为。

sentences.en: So what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So that brings us to Monday.
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了周一。

sentences.en: It's clear by Monday that Democrats will move to expel Tony Gonzalez.
sentences.zh: 到周一很明显，民主党人将采取行动驱逐托尼·冈萨雷斯。

sentences.en: Republicans will move to expel Swalwell.
sentences.zh: 共和党人将采取行动驱逐斯沃韦尔。

sentences.en: And everyone is expecting that if those votes go through, Republicans will try to expel Sheila Sheffelis-McCormick.
sentences.zh: 每个人都预计，如果这些投票通过，共和党人将试图驱逐希拉·谢菲利斯-麦考密克。

sentences.en: And Democrats will try to expel Corey Mills.
sentences.zh: 而民主党人将试图驱逐科里·米尔斯。

sentences.en: And that the House would be taking these extraordinary actions, potentially getting rid of four members before all of them have had their thorough investigations.
sentences.zh: 众议院将采取这些非同寻常的行动，可能在所有人都经过彻底调查之前就除掉四名成员。

sentences.en: And that would be unprecedented, right?
sentences.zh: 那将是史无前例的，对吧？

sentences.en: Four people at once expelled?
sentences.zh: 一次驱逐四个人？

sentences.en: Yeah, think about it.
sentences.zh: 是的，想想看。

sentences.en: It was six over 200-some years.
sentences.zh: 在两百多年里一共才六个。

sentences.en: And then to have four at once would have been absolutely incredible.
sentences.zh: 而一次性驱逐四个将是绝对不可思议的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But that decision ends up being taken out of members' hands because Eric Swalwell, after ending his campaign for governor, is still facing significant pressure.
sentences.zh: 但这个决定最终从议员手中被拿走了，因为埃里克·斯沃韦尔在结束州长竞选后，仍然面临巨大的压力。

sentences.en: And he announces on Monday that he's going to resign from Congress.
sentences.zh: 他在周一宣布他将辞去国会议员职务。

sentences.en: In his resignation letter, Swalwell writing, I am deeply sorry to my family, staff, and constituents for mistakes in judgment I've made in my paSt.
sentences.zh: 在辞职信中，斯沃韦尔写道：我对我过去所犯的判断错误向我的家人、员工和选民深表歉意。

sentences.en: I will fight these serious, false allegations made against me.
sentences.zh: 我将反击这些针对我的严重、虚假的指控。

sentences.en: However, I must take responsibility and ownership for the mistakes I did make.
sentences.zh: 然而，我必须为我所犯的错误承担责任。

sentences.en: And then about an hour later,
sentences.zh: 大约一小时后，

sentences.en: Texas Republican Congressman Tony Gonzalez also announcing on social media he plans to resign.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州共和党国会议员托尼·冈萨雷斯也在社交媒体上宣布他计划辞职。

sentences.en: Tony Gonzalez announces that he'll be doing the same.
sentences.zh: 托尼·冈萨雷斯宣布他也会这样做。

sentences.en: Michael, does it strike you as sort of unlikely that the two of them would suddenly and sort of coincidentally have both decided to resign at roughly the same time?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你是否觉得他们两人突然且巧合地在大致相同的时间决定辞职有点不太可能？

sentences.en: Like, what do we know about how they both came to that decision in that moment?
sentences.zh: 比如，关于他们两人当时是如何做出这个决定的，我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: That's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I think we're still reporting on this.
sentences.zh: 我想我们还在对此进行报道。

sentences.en: But there was a sense that Swalwell's position was increasingly untenable, that so many Democrats had abandoned him, and that a number of Democratic women said explicitly,
sentences.zh: 但有一种感觉，斯沃韦尔的处境越来越站不住脚，太多的民主党人抛弃了他，而且一些民主党女性明确表示，

sentences.en: I will vote to oust Eric Swalwell, and I will also vote to oust Tony Gonzalez.
sentences.zh: 我将投票罢免埃里克·斯沃韦尔，我也将投票罢免托尼·冈萨雷斯。

sentences.en: And you had a number of Republican women saying the same.
sentences.zh: 你也有一些共和党女性说了同样的话。

sentences.en: Both of these men have committed serious accusations of misconduct that I find credible, and I'm going to get rid of them both.
sentences.zh: 这两名男子都犯下了我认为可信的严重不当行为指控，我要把他们两个都除掉。

sentences.en: But there's a sense that members don't want to have to take votes like this.
sentences.zh: 但有一种感觉，议员们不想被迫进行这样的投票。

sentences.en: Even when they feel like it's a cut-and-dry situation, they don't want to vote to expel any of their colleagues without due process,
sentences.zh: 即使他们觉得这是个简单明了的情况，他们也不想在没有正当程序的情况下投票驱逐任何同事，

sentences.en: because they don't know if someday they'll be accused of something in a newspaper article that they might have to defend themselves about.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不知道有一天自己是否也会在报纸文章中被指控某些事情，而不得不为自己辩护。

sentences.en: Since Swalwell resigned, there was another woman who came forward in a press conference on Tuesday with accusations against him.
sentences.zh: 自斯沃韦尔辞职以来，周二又有另一名女性在新闻发布会上站出来对他提出指控。

sentences.en: And I wonder whether there was a possibility that Swalwell will face any criminal consequences relating to any of these accusations from any of these women.
sentences.zh: 我想知道斯沃韦尔是否有可能因这些女性提出的任何指控而面临刑事后果。

sentences.en: Yeah, so the press conference that you're talking about was happening as Swalwell was filing his resignation letter.
sentences.zh: 是的，你提到的那个新闻发布会是在斯沃韦尔提交辞职信时发生的。

sentences.en: My name is Lana Drews.
sentences.zh: 我叫拉娜·德鲁斯。

sentences.en: In 2018, while I was living and working as a model in Beverly Hills, and I also owned a fashion software company,
sentences.zh: 2018年，当时我住在比佛利山庄，以模特为业，同时还拥有一家时尚软件公司，

sentences.en: I had contact with Eric Swalwell on three separate occasions after meeting him socially.
sentences.zh: 在社交场合结识埃里克·斯沃韦尔后，我曾与他有过三次单独接触。

sentences.en: And this woman, Lana Drews, came forward publicly.
sentences.zh: 而这位名叫拉娜·德鲁斯的女士公开站了出来。

sentences.en: On the third occasion, I believe he drugged my drink.
sentences.zh: 第三次见面时，我相信他在我的饮料里下了药。

sentences.en: And said that Swalwell drugged and sexually assaulted her.
sentences.zh: 并称斯沃韦尔对她下药并进行了性侵犯。

sentences.en: He raped me, and he choked me.
sentences.zh: 他强奸了我，还掐住了我的脖子。

sentences.en: And while he was choking me, I lost consciousness.
sentences.zh: 在他掐我的时候，我失去了知觉。

sentences.en: And this was difficult to hear.
sentences.zh: 听到这些令人感到沉重。

sentences.en: I think it continued to shock many people.
sentences.zh: 我想这依然让许多人感到震惊。

sentences.en: And I stand with the other women who have come forward.
sentences.zh: 我支持其他站出来的女性。

sentences.en: And I will be making a report to law enforcement shortly with my attorneys.
sentences.zh: 我很快会和我的律师一起向执法部门提交报告。

sentences.en: Her lawyer said that they would be sharing that evidence with law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 她的律师表示，他们将与执法部门分享这些证据。

sentences.en: So it's very possible that he will face a criminal investigation in that case.
sentences.zh: 所以，他很有可能因此面临刑事调查。

sentences.en: And we should note that he denied these allegations as well through his lawyer.
sentences.zh: 我们也应该注意到，他通过律师否认了这些指控。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And we also know that the Manhattan District Attorney is investigating one of the accusations that he raped a woman in 2024 in a hotel room in New York.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，曼哈顿地区检察官正在调查其中一项指控，即他于2024年在纽约一家酒店房间内强奸了一名女性。

sentences.en: And if there are more accusers, it's entirely possible that we'll see more criminal investigations come forward.
sentences.zh: 如果还有更多的指控者，我们完全有可能看到更多的刑事调查出现。

sentences.en: The resignations of these two men, Tony Gonzalez, Eric Swalwell, it's hard not to see those resignations as effectively shielding Congress
sentences.zh: 托尼·冈萨雷斯和埃里克·斯沃韦尔这两人的辞职，很难不让人认为这实际上是在保护国会，

sentences.en: from having to decide what to do with them, right?
sentences.zh: 使其不必决定如何处置他们，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, they basically got to choose, in some form or fashion, their own fate, rather than having Congress punish them, take some kind of action about them.
sentences.zh: 就像是，他们基本上是以某种形式选择了自己的命运，而不是由国会来惩罚他们或采取某种行动。

sentences.en: I know that we can't predict what might have happened.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们无法预测可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: But based on all of your experience reporting on the Hill, Michael, I wonder, do you think that Congress would have actually voted to expel these members had push come to shove?
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔，基于你报道国会山的所有经验，我想知道，你认为如果事态发展到那一步，国会真的会投票驱逐这些议员吗？

sentences.en: I generally hesitate to make absolute predictions when it comes to Congress.
sentences.zh: 在涉及国会的问题上，我通常不愿做出绝对的预测。

sentences.en: And the vote to expel a member is a high bar.
sentences.zh: 而且驱逐议员的投票门槛很高。

sentences.en: It's a two-thirds majority, which is not easy to clear.
sentences.zh: 需要三分之二的多数票，这并不容易达到。

sentences.en: It took three tries for them to expel George Santos.
sentences.zh: 他们花了三次尝试才驱逐了乔治·桑托斯。

sentences.en: At the same time, I think the nature of the accusations against Swalwell and the fact that Gonzalez admitted to misconduct would have made it really easy for a lot of members
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我认为针对斯沃韦尔的指控性质，以及冈萨雷斯承认存在不当行为的事实，会让很多议员觉得投票将他们逐出变得非常容易。

sentences.en: to vote them out.
sentences.zh: 投票将他们逐出。

sentences.en: And there was a sense that there was an eye for an eye here, that it wasn't as hard of a choice when you knew that you could take out a Republican
sentences.zh: 当时有一种“以眼还眼”的感觉，当你意识到可以同时除掉一名共和党人和一名民主党人，且权力平衡不会发生改变时，这就不再是一个艰难的选择了。

sentences.en: and a Democrat at the same time and the balance of power wouldn't shift.
sentences.zh: 且权力平衡不会发生改变。

sentences.en: So the upshot of that is what, Michael?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，这带来的结果是什么呢？

sentences.en: That accountability is only possible when it's politically palatable?
sentences.zh: 难道只有在政治上可接受时，问责才有可能实现吗？

sentences.en: I think that's a question that members of Congress are really going to have to answer for themselves this week.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是国会议员本周必须亲自回答的问题。

sentences.en: And they're still living in the fallout that these two resignations have created.
sentences.zh: 而且他们仍然生活在这两次辞职所造成的余波之中。

sentences.en: Because when you look at Tony Gonzalez, the accusation didn't change.
sentences.zh: 因为当你审视托尼·冈萨雷斯时，指控并没有改变。

sentences.en: His admission of violating this rule didn't change.
sentences.zh: 他承认违反规则的事实也没有改变。

sentences.en: But what changed is there was finally a Democrat that they could pair him with and take both of them out.
sentences.zh: 但改变的是，终于有一位民主党人可以与他配对，从而将他们两人一并除掉。

sentences.en: And Congress is going to continue confronting this issue because Sheila Sheffelis-McCormick, the Democrat from Florida, she has an ethics hearing next week.
sentences.zh: 国会将继续面对这个问题，因为来自佛罗里达州的民主党人希拉·谢菲利斯-麦考密克下周将举行道德听证会。

sentences.en: And it's entirely possible that the Ethics Committee will recommend that Congress expel her and there will be a vote on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 道德委员会完全有可能建议国会驱逐她，届时众议院将进行投票。

sentences.en: That would put Democrats down a vote.
sentences.zh: 那将导致民主党少了一张选票。

sentences.en: And they're going to have to decide what to do about that.
sentences.zh: 他们将不得不决定如何处理这件事。

sentences.en: And all the while, Corey Mills is still being investigated by the committee.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，科里·米尔斯仍在接受委员会的调查。

sentences.en: And a lot of Democrats would like to see action taken against him too.
sentences.zh: 许多民主党人也希望看到对他采取行动。

sentences.en: So I think this brings us back to where we started, which is, what do you do when a member of Congress is accused of misconduct?
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这让我们回到了起点，那就是，当国会议员被指控行为不当时，你该怎么办？

sentences.en: Do you leave it to the voters to decide their fate?
sentences.zh: 是留给选民来决定他们的命运吗？

sentences.en: Put it in their hands because they're the ones who elect their representatives?
sentences.zh: 把决定权交到他们手中，因为他们才是选举代表的人？

sentences.en: Or do you say enough is enough?
sentences.zh: 还是说，忍无可忍，无需再忍？

sentences.en: Do you take matters into your own hands?
sentences.zh: 是你自己采取行动吗？

sentences.en: Let's decide to expel them and punish them for their actions?
sentences.zh: 决定驱逐他们并为他们的行为惩罚他们？

sentences.en: And take that will away from the American people.
sentences.zh: 并剥夺美国人民的那种意愿。

sentences.en: Michael Gold, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·戈尔德，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，雷切尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一——《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人们制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: Israel agreed to a 10-day ceasefire in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 以色列同意在黎巴嫩停火10天。

sentences.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that he would pause attacks targeting Hezbollah, but that Israeli troops would not withdraw.
sentences.zh: 以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡表示，他将暂停针对真主党的袭击，但以色列军队不会撤出。

sentences.en: The truce, which began at 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 这项停火协议于周四东部时间下午5点开始生效，

sentences.en: Eastern on Thursday, could remove a major hurdle to broader talks to end the U.S.-Iran war.
sentences.zh: 可能会消除结束美伊战争更广泛谈判的一个主要障碍。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration has selected Dr. Erica Schwartz, a physician and vaccine supporter who served as a deputy surgeon general during President Trump's first term,
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府已选择埃里卡·施瓦茨博士担任疾病控制与预防中心主任，她是一位医生和疫苗支持者，曾在特朗普第一个任期内担任副卫生局长。

sentences.en: to become the director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
sentences.zh: 担任疾病控制与预防中心主任。

sentences.en: Dr. Schwartz's views on vaccines are much more conventional than those of her boss.
sentences.zh: 施瓦茨博士对疫苗的看法比她的老板要传统得多。

sentences.en: Health Secretary Robert F.
sentences.zh: 卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪，

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr., who faced tough questioning from Democrats during a congressional budget hearing on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 他在周四的国会预算听证会上受到了民主党人的严厉质询。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由凯特琳·奥基夫、安娜·福利、埃里克·克鲁普克和罗谢尔·邦吉亚制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester and Liz O'Balen.
sentences.zh: 由雷切尔·奎斯特和利兹·奥巴伦编辑。

sentences.zh: 并包含艾丽西亚·比图布和马里昂·洛萨诺的音乐。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly创作。

sentences.zh: 本期节目由艾丽莎·莫克斯利担任工程制作。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·亚伯拉罕斯。

sentences.en: See you on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 周日见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人激动的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《Metro》的最新一期节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro, listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》，请在你收听播客的地方订阅收听。
